result.brief: 提出 RoAR-VAE，通过从损坏潜变量预测语义特征与重建图像的双重鲁棒目标，提升视觉 tokenizer 潜空间的扩散可学习性，兼顾重建保真与生成性能。
result.reason: Proposes a visual tokenizer/VAE with robust semantic alignment and reconstruction objectives to improve latent diffusability, directly addressing RAE-style generative latent spaces and representation alignment.
